scripts.title: Auto XP Loop
scripts.script:
local Remote = game:GetService("ReplicatedStorage"):WaitForChild("ReplicatedStorageHolders"):WaitForChild("Events"):WaitForChild("AddXP")

getgenv().AutoXP = true 

task.spawn(function()
    while getgenv().AutoXP do
        local args = { 100000 }
        Remote:FireServer(unpack(args))
        task.wait() 
    end
end)

scripts.title: Auto Cash and Xp
scripts.script:
local ReplicatedStorage = game:GetService("ReplicatedStorage")
local Events = ReplicatedStorage
	:WaitForChild("ReplicatedStorageHolders")
	:WaitForChild("Events")

while true do
	Events:WaitForChild("AddCoins"):FireServer(20000)
	Events:WaitForChild("AddXP"):FireServer(20000)
	task.wait(0.1)
end
